newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers still at a standstill, USDA said. Buyer inquiry fair. Bids ran from $108.00 to $109.00, with a few $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis on afternoon rounds. Producers priced stock $111.00 to $112.00. Most recent established market last Thursday at $110.00-$111.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs -
several loads 67.00. Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales.
For week - 5,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 7,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 7,700
